Hi Naomi,

We're preparing our internal reconciliation ahead of the renewal conversation and need a per-line usage export to reconcile against the proposal in DS-8371. My AP team also wants to make sure the upcoming invoice matches the commit tiers we discussed.

Can you send:
- CSV with daily line items for the past 90 days (token-level columns: prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, embeddings_tokens where applicable)
- Model name & region per call (so we can match cost per-model)
- Any proration or credits applied between Oct 15 - Nov 30

I've attached our internal/derived usage file for context (usage_export_Q4.csv). Please let me know if you need the HubSpot deal ID or a sample mapping file.

Thanks,

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the file and the clear ask. I can get a line-item export out, but a couple of quick clarifications so we give you exactly what AP needs:

1) Token columns: do you want a single aggregated token_count per day, or split by prompt_tokens vs completion_tokens? We can deliver both.
2) Model mapping: do you need the exact model revision string (e.g., redwood-v1.3-quant) or just the catalog name (e.g., redwood-v1)?
3) Billing vs usage windows: our billing cut is at UTC midnight; your attachment looks like it uses PST — confirm which timezone you'd like the CSV collapsed to.

Proposed deliverable (if that's ok):
- CSV with daily rows, columns: date(UTC), model_revision, region, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost_usd, invoice_reference
- A short reconciliation note listing proration/credits applied this quarter
- Draft commit schedule PDF with suggested commit tiers (sending as draft_commit_schedule.pdf)

Marissa and Jordan — looping you in because we may propose a small sweetener if Datastore moves to a higher monthly commit (they're borderline between Tier B and Tier C).

I can have the export and reconciliation note to you by EOD tomorrow (Nov 30) if you confirm the token split and timezone.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: draft_commit_schedule.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Quick note —

If Datastore confirms a 20% uplift to their committed monthly tokens (move to Tier C) we can offer:
- 7% sustained per-token discount on usage above commit, and
- 60-day amortized onboarding credit to offset any immediate overage this billing cycle (applied as an invoice line item called "onboarding credit - DS-8371").

Also recommend we provide them with a recurring SFTP/CSV export model (daily file drop) and a monthly aggregated ledger for AP. Naomi — can you confirm whether we should offer a webhook push instead (engineering can support webhook or SFTP depending on their security posture).

I'll draft the amendment language to add to the MSA once Naomi confirms the uplift intent.

—Marissa

Naomi / Marissa —

Thanks, that all sounds good. Confirmations:
- Please split prompt_tokens and completion_tokens in the CSV (we'll aggregate internally).
- Model revision string not required; catalog name is fine.
- Use UTC for dates in the CSV.
- Datastore is willing to commit to a 20% uplift (Tier C) pending final wording and effective date Jan 1.

Two asks from AP before we sign:
1) A sample invoice with the onboarding credit line and the discount applied so they can map to our GL.
2) A recurring daily export (SFTP) or secure webhook — our security team would prefer SFTP and can provide a host and key.

If you can send the sample invoice and the CSV schema, we'll route to our procurement and legal.

Appreciate the speedy turnaround.

Liam
